---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
    shortened_season = yearID %in% shortened_seasons
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray70", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(
    data = hr_by_season |> filter(!shortened_season),
    color = "steelblue",
    size = 1.5,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = hr_by_season |> filter(shortened_season),
    aes(color = "Shortened seasons"),
    size = 2.5,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Shortened seasons" = "firebrick", "Regular seasons" = "steelblue"),
    name = "Season type"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Game by Season (Shortened Seasons Highlighted)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Game (HR / Team-Games)",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database; shortened seasons are highlighted for reference."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
library(knitr)

comparison <- Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    season = yearID,
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
  ) |>
  select(season, total_home_runs, total_team_games, home_runs_per_game) |>
  arrange(factor(season, levels = c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)))

comparison |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Season", "Total Home Runs", "Total Team-Games", "Home Runs per Game"),
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Comparison of 2019 with the three suspicious seasons"
  )
```
